newsitem.title: INDIA: India CRISIL to launch new equity index.
newsitem.headline: India CRISIL to launch new equity index.

text.p: The Credit Rating Information Services of India Ltd (CRISIL) will launch on Wednesday a new index for state-owned firms, the rating agency said in a statement on Tuesday.
The market value weighted index will comprise 20 public sector enterprises (PSEs) and will be called CRISIL PSE Equity Index, it said.

The objective of the index is: "..to provide regulators, investors and market intermediaries with an appropriate benchmark that captures the performance of this segment of the market, as well as to provide an appropriate basis for pricing of future issues of PSEs."
The index will serve as a benchmark for the government's divestment programme.
"All PSEs in which the government has to date partly disinvested in, have hence been considered for inclusion in the CRISIL PSE Index," the statement said.
The index excludes state-run financial institutions and banks, it added.
